dataset.name: synthetic_lab_mix
dataset.split_strategy: not applicable: no learned model; synthetic deterministic events only

method: Three clean temporary SQLite runs per mode. Baseline normalizes and stores only; full mode adds rule and anomaly evaluation, alert inserts, entity correlation and incident updates.
limitations: Synthetic sequential workload; no concurrent producer or labelled ground truth. Does not establish field precision/recall, endpoint-day false positives, broker lag or production capacity. Storage per million is linear extrapolation.
